name: Social Games
summary: Quick games you can play right in your browser. No downloads, no sign-up.
details: Led by Whot, the classic Naija card game of shapes and numbers, in three modes: Classic, Match the Card and Higher or Lower.
Alongside it sit arcade and puzzle favourites: Snake, Tetris, Sudoku, 2048 and Whack-a-Mole. More games are on the way.
features: Plays in the browser, no account needed
